login.description: Your credentials pass through our server over HTTPS to reach UPPCL, but are never stored or logged. The entire codebase is open-source.

app.balance_line: ₹{balance} left · you use about ₹{perDay} a day
app.insight_calm: Usage is steady. Nothing needs your attention.
app.projected: This month's bill will be about ₹{amount}
app.unusual_day: {date}: {v} units, much more than your usual {avg}
app.unusual_days: {n} days used much more than usual · highest {date}, {v} units
app.no_unusual: No unusual days in this period.
app.due_unknown: UPPCL isn't saying right now whether a bill is due. If you're expecting one, check its due date on the bill or on UPPCL SMART.
app.list_unavailable: UPPCL didn't answer. Pull down to try again.
app.none_statements: No bills yet. They'll show here once UPPCL issues one.
app.none_recharges: No recharges in the last few months. Your recharges will show here.
app.no_complaints: No complaints on your registered number. Power problem? Report it above.
app.unofficial: Unofficial app. Not affiliated with UPPCL or any electricity company. Your data comes straight from UPPCL SMART.
app.login_sub: Sign in with your UPPCL SMART account
app.login_privacy: Your password goes only to UPPCL.
app.alerts_desc: A notification when your balance has about 3 days left. Checks about twice a day.
app.alerts_password: To check while the app is closed, Bijli Saathi keeps your UPPCL password on this phone, encrypted by Android. Turn alerts off to delete it.
app.alerts_denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for Bijli Saathi in Android settings.
app.notif_body: ₹{balance} left. A ₹{amount} recharge covers you until about {date}.
app.no_power_desc: Files with UPPCL 1912 for your home in one tap.
app.status_desc: Complaints filed from your registered mobile number
app.projected_short: If you keep using power like this, {month}'s bill will be about ₹{amount}
app.credit_key: Green = credit carried to your next bill
app.registered_desc: UPPCL uses these for your bills, alerts and complaint status.
app.name: Name
app.phone_mismatch: Your app login uses {app} but your bill record has {bill}. We check complaints for both; update the old one on UPPCL SMART.
app.budget_desc: We'll warn you if this month's bill looks set to cross it. Bill reminders need to be on.
app.budget_notif_body: At your current use it's heading for about ₹{proj}. See what's using more in Usage.
app.not_supported_yet: Other details can't be changed in this app yet.
app.change_on_official: Change them on UPPCL's official site
app.pay_billdesk_short: Secured by BillDesk · UPI, cards, net banking
app.pay_upi_tip: Tip: choose UPI to pay with GPay, PhonePe or Paytm.
app.pay_upi_back: Finish in your UPI app, then come back here: this page confirms the payment by itself.
app.pay_upi_none: No UPI app opened on this phone. Choose UPI ID, cards or net banking instead.
app.paid_updating: UPPCL updates your balance in a few hours. No need to pay again.
app.paid_remainder: UPPCL has your ₹{paid} payment. ₹{left} is still due on this bill.
app.c19_why: Complaints live on UPPCL's 1912 service, which is separate from your UPPCL SMART sign-in. 1912 texts a code to confirm the number is yours. You do this once; the app keeps you connected as long as 1912 allows.
app.c19_first_time: First time on 1912? It will also ask you, once, to register your connection on its website. The app shows you how.
app.c19_sent_to: 1912 sent a 6-digit code to {mobile}. It fills in by itself when the SMS arrives.
app.c19_kyc_body: 1912 needs this number registered with your connection before it shows or takes complaints. It's a one-time step on 1912's website.
app.c19_kyc_steps: On 1912: sign in with this number, open "Register Yourself", search your account number, confirm the code it sends, and Save. Then come back and connect again.
app.c19_card_body: Every complaint on your number, open and closed, with its status. Needs a one-time code from 1912.
app.c19_stale: Showing your last saved list. 1912 needs a new code to refresh it.
app.c19_expired: 1912 needs a new code to show your complaints.
app.rp_filing_paused: UPPCL changed how 1912 takes complaints, and filing from the app is being updated. Right now, report it here:
app.rp_1912_login: The app can file for you once 1912 is connected. Right now, report it here:
app.rp_1912_link: 1912 files only for connections added to your 1912 number. Add this one once on 1912.uppcl.org (Register Account, with an OTP). Right now, report it here:
app.cx_1912_login: 1912 needs a code from your phone to show complaints. Connect once to see them here.
app.pay_qr_note: Scan with GPay, PhonePe or any UPI app on another phone. Keep this screen open: it confirms the payment by itself.
app.pay_advance_note: You can pay in advance; UPPCL takes advance payments in multiples of ₹1,000 and adjusts them in your next bill.
app.pay_rule_min: To pay the bill, enter at least ₹{amount}.
app.pay_rule_part: Part payment must be between ₹{min} and ₹{max}.
app.pay_rule_advance: Advance payments must be in multiples of ₹1,000.
app.pay_rule_whole: Enter a whole amount in rupees.
app.pay_done_desc: UPPCL has received your payment. It can take a few hours to show in your bill history.
app.pay_failed_desc: If money was deducted, your bank usually returns it in a few days. Keep the reference number.
app.pay_pending_desc: BillDesk hasn't confirmed yet. Please don't pay again; check back in a little while.
app.bill_on_way_line: Estimated from the {units} units you used in {month} · arrives early {next}
app.bill_expected: Arrives in the first days of {next}
app.how_pending: We multiply the units you used in {month} by {rateSrc}. The real bill can differ a little, for example the month's last reading and fixed charges.
app.prepaid_month_estimate: If you keep using power like this, this month will cost about ₹{amount}
app.month_estimate_line: If you keep using power the way you have recently
app.details_unavailable: UPPCL's consumer portal isn't responding right now, so these are the details from your UPPCL SMART account.
app.err_network_body: Check your internet. If it's working, {system} may be down; try again in a few minutes.
app.err_upstream_body: This is on UPPCL's side, not your phone or this app. Try again in a few minutes.
app.err_app_body: This looks like a bug in the app, not UPPCL. Copy the details and report it.
app.details_from_smart: Meanwhile, from your UPPCL SMART account:
app.update_desc: Get the latest fixes. The new version installs over this one; your settings stay.
app.link_blocked: This link can't be opened in the app.
app.pay_awaiting_bill: {month}'s bill isn't out yet: UPPCL usually issues it in the first days of the month. You can pay it here once it arrives, or pay something in advance now.
app.loading_slow: UPPCL is taking a while to answer. Still trying…
app.login_slow: UPPCL SMART is taking too long to answer. Try again in a moment; your internet is fine.
app.login_bad_credentials: Wrong username or password. Check both and try again.
app.login_offline: No internet connection. Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data (and that airplane mode is off), then try again.
app.unofficial_short: Unofficial app · not affiliated with UPPCL
app.unlock_desc: Your meter details are locked on this phone.
app.pdf_error: Couldn't open this PDF. Check your internet and try again in a few minutes.
app.not_billed: Not billed yet · bill comes early {next}
app.rebate_total: You saved ₹{amount} by paying before the due date. UPPCL takes about 1% off any bill paid on time.
app.stale: Couldn't reach UPPCL. Showing your last data.
app.rp_their_account: Their account number (10 digits, on their bill)
app.rp_danger_row: Sparking, a fallen wire or fire
app.rp_slow: 1912 is slow to answer right now. You can send an SMS complaint instead:
app.rp_next: The line engineer gets it now. UPPCL sends updates by SMS.
app.rp_next_place: The line engineer at {place} gets it now. UPPCL sends updates by SMS.
app.rp_danger: Sparking, a fallen wire or fire
app.rp_other_by_text: This connection isn't on your 1912 number, so send the complaint by SMS or WhatsApp. UPPCL will text you a complaint number. It won't show in this app.
app.rp_note_voltage: Low or flickering voltage at home since {time}.
app.rp_note_phase: Power in only some rooms since {time}: one phase seems to be out.
app.rp_blocked: 1912 won't take a new complaint yet: {msg}. Check Complaints for the open one.
app.rp_filed_no: Complaint number {no}. The engineer for your area has it.
app.rp_filed_pending: UPPCL has it. The complaint number shows in Complaints within a few minutes.
app.rp_planned: UPPCL has planned work in your area: {notice}. Power should come back when it ends.
app.rp_already_open: You already have an open complaint ({type}, {t}). A new one won't speed it up.
app.day_busiest: Most of the day's power went between {from} and {to} ({pct}%).
app.cx_call_order: Still not fixed? Call them in this order.
app.tap_bar: Tap a bar to see that day
app.pf_risk: Your bill may get a penalty for poor power quality ({pf}). See Meter details.
app.demand_risk: You used {pct}% of your connection's {kw} kW limit. Above 85% can add a penalty.
app.arrears_warn: ₹{amount} in arrears. Pay it to avoid disconnection.
app.uppcl_tickets: Also in the UPPCL SMART app
app.widget_setup: Open Bijli Saathi to set up
app.alerts_post_desc: A notification when a new bill is ready, and 3 days before it's due if unpaid. Also planned power cuts.
app.test_body: This is how alerts will look. You can turn them off in Settings.
app.session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again to see your meter.
app.signout_body: You'll need to sign in again (password or a code). Reminders and the home-screen widget stop until you do.
app.how_prepaid: Days left = your balance ÷ your average daily charge over the last 30 days. The suggestion tops you up to about 40 days.
app.how_estimate: We take your average daily use lately, for every day of {month}, at {rateSrc}. It assumes you keep using power the way you have recently.
app.rate_src_bill: what one unit cost on your last bill (about {rate})
app.rate_src_recent: what one unit has cost you lately (about {rate})
app.rate_src_typical: a typical home rate (about {rate}), because UPPCL isn't sending your last bill right now
app.how_postpaid: We multiply the units you've used since the 1st by {rateSrc}. The estimate assumes you keep using power the way you have recently.
app.pay_copied: Account number copied. Paste it on UPPCL's page.
app.tap_bar_month: Tap a bar to see that month
app.meter_details_desc: Technical details from UPPCL for when you want to dig deeper.
app.pf_desc: Below 0.90 can add a penalty to your bill
app.peak_demand: Highest load in the last 30 days
app.peak_desc: Your sanctioned load is {kw} kW. Staying under 85% avoids demand penalties.
app.no_messages: No messages or alarms from UPPCL.
app.si_sent_sms: We sent a code to {to}. It fills in by itself.
app.si_looks_account: This looks like an account number. Enter your mobile number, or sign in with password.
app.si_wrong_code: That code is wrong. Check the SMS and type it again.
app.si_expired_code: This code has expired. Tap Send again for a new one.
app.si_too_many: Too many tries. Wait a while, or sign in with password.
app.si_no_sms: No SMS? Check the number, or wait — UPPCL's SMS can take a few minutes.
app.si_forgot_note: No password needed. We'll send a code to your mobile.
app.si_privacy_code: Your number and code go only to UPPCL.
app.su_account: Account number (10 digits, on your bill)
app.su_sent: We sent a code to the mobile UPPCL has for this account ({to}).
app.su_sent_unknown: We sent a code to the mobile UPPCL has for this account.
app.su_not_mine_body: The code goes only to the mobile UPPCL has for this account. To change it, call 1912 or visit your electricity office with your bill. Until then you can sign in with your password.
app.su_password_hint: At least 8 characters. Use letters and numbers.
app.su_already: This account already has a UPPCL SMART login. Sign in with the code or your password.
app.su_unknown_acct: UPPCL doesn't know this account number. Check it on your bill.
app.cx_open_late: UPPCL's {h}-hour limit has passed. Call the Junior Engineer (JE).
app.cx_comp_title: Fixed later than UPPCL's own time limit
app.cx_comp_body: 1912 has a form to ask for compensation for delays. UPPCL decides if it applies.
app.cx_comp_steps: On 1912: sign in, open "Compensation / मुआवज़ा" and pick complaint #{no}.
app.pl_on_body: Your bill will go to {email}. The paper bill will stop coming.
app.pl_no_email: Add an email to UPPCL first
app.pl_no_email_body: Email bills go to the email on your UPPCL SMART account, and there isn't one yet. Add it on UPPCL's site, then switch this on.
app.pl_portal_differs: UPPCL's billing office still shows {mode}. It can take one bill cycle to change.
app.sh_what: People you add can see this connection's bills, payments and daily units in their own UPPCL SMART login. They cannot change your account.
app.sh_none: You haven't shared this connection with anyone.
app.sh_trust: Only add people you trust. Daily usage can show when your home is empty.
app.sh_sms_note: They'll get an SMS from UPPCL. They need to sign in to UPPCL SMART with this number.
app.sh_resent: Sent again. Try again tomorrow if needed.
app.sh_remove_body: They won't see this connection any more. You can add them again later.
app.pl_placeholder: Your e-bills go to a UPPCL placeholder address, not to you. Your own email {own} is only on file at the billing office. Ask UPPCL to set it for e-bills, or switch back to paper.
app.pl_placeholder_none: Your e-bills go to a UPPCL placeholder address, not to you. Add your own email on UPPCL's site, or switch back to paper.
app.no_power_desc_connect: Connect 1912 once with a code, then it's one tap.
app.c19_connect_next: Connect 1912 for one-tap filing next time
app.si_forgot_user_note: No username needed. Sign in with your mobile number and a code.
app.alerts_pw_code: Sign in with codes only? Use the password you set on UPPCL SMART. Never set one? Choose "Forgot password" on the UPPCL SMART site or app first.
app.alerts_pw_wrong: That password didn't work with UPPCL SMART. Check it and try again.
app.alerts_pw_failed: Couldn't check the password with UPPCL just now. Check your internet and try again.
app.cx_no_limit: 1912 doesn't publish a time limit for this kind of complaint.
app.outage_on: UPPCL has logged an outage on {where}
app.outage_on_line: UPPCL has logged an outage on your line
